findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure use of subprocess without shell=True (sanity check)
 * @description Finds all uses of subprocess.* to understand command execution surface.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/wheel/subprocess-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "run", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to subprocess API here (for surface analysis)."
findings.hypothesis: Map all subprocess usage to understand command execution surface; verify no shell=True or user-controlled input.
